name: kb_674_Normalized

schema.description: PersistentVolumeClaimVolumeSource references the user's PVC in the same namespace. This volume finds the bound PV and mounts that volume for the pod. A PersistentVolumeClaimVolumeSource is, essentially, a wrapper around another type of volume that is owned by someone else (the system).

claimName.description: ClaimName is the name of a PersistentVolumeClaim in the same namespace as the pod using this volume. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#persistentvolumeclaims

readOnly.description: Will force the ReadOnly setting in VolumeMounts. Default false.

description:
Hi team,

The pod will use the PersistentVolumeClaim named **data-volume-claim** from the same namespace. The volume is attached with full read‑write permissions, as the ReadOnly flag is set to false. Let me know if any adjustments are needed.
